name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU strategic objectives for the 20th meeting of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES), to be held in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, from 24 November to 5 December 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what the European Union should push for at a global meeting on the wildlife trade, held in Uzbekistan in late 2025. It asks for stronger enforcement against wildlife crime, better tracking of traded animals and plants, and tighter rules on ivory, eels, sharks and big cats. It also calls for a common EU list of animals allowed as pets and for binding EU rules on ivory instead of guidance.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is the Parliament's wish list for the meeting; EU rules would follow later.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, the European Commission, traders and importers of wildlife, and pet keepers.
- **What happens next:** EU negotiators take these positions to the meeting from 24 November to 5 December 2025.
